message_2:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@orchardai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick intro — signed up, looking for a short demo + fit Qs

Hey Samira — great to meet you and glad the docs were helpful.

Quick set of things that help us tailor the 30-min session so it’s immediately actionable: 
1) Primary use case: is the goal purely search (embeddings -> rerank) or are you planning to use generation in the UX (summaries, follow-ups)?
2) Volume: rough monthly token/embedding estimates (or sample QPS) during the pilot and expected production ramp (e.g., 100k embeddings/month -> 2M tokens/month).
3) Latency SLO: do you need sub-200ms p50, sub-500ms p95, or is a few-second response acceptable?
4) Pilot timeline: when do you want a production-ready pilot (target month / quarter)?
5) Security/compliance: any datasource residency, HIPAA/PCI, or encryption-HSM requirements to flag up-front?
6) Who from your side will attend (engineer, PM, legal/Sec)?

If you can reply with short bullets, I’ll:
- put together a 30-min agenda tailored to your answers,
- share an internal signup telemetry PDF (so you have an early cost/throughput snapshot), and
- propose two slots.

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Wed Nov 11, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Nov 12, 14:00–14:30 PT

Or pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo

Ben (cc) will join if we need deeper throughput/cost discussion.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
SDR, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

Note: I attached the signup-internal-report.pdf to this thread for quick telemetry context (internal stub).

> 5) Security/compliance: any datasource residency, HIPAA/PCI, or encryption-HSM requirements to flag up-front?

Thanks — answers below: 
- Use case: embedding search + short autogenerated summaries (one-sentence) to surface in support UI; we may add follow-up questions later but pilot = search+summaries.
- Volume: pilot will index ~250k docs (mostly transcripts). Expect ~400k embedding lookups/month and ~1.8M generated tokens/month (spiky; peak qps ~6).
- Latency SLO: aiming for p95 < 600ms for search + summary. p50 target < 200ms would be ideal but not required for the pilot.
- Timeline: target pilot launch in mid-February 2027 (internal roadmap says Feb 15). Production ramp in Q2 2027 if pilot looks good.
- Security: no HIPAA, but we need data residency in us-east for internal policy. AES-GCM KMS support preferred.
- Attendees: Samira (Head ML) + Miguel (engineer) will attend the demo.

Proposed slot: Thu Nov 12, 14:00–14:30 PT works for us — please confirm and send an agenda.

Thanks,
Samira
